title: How to use Batch Jobs and get 50% off your AI Costs

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI and CGI video on an OpenAI and Azure OpenAI specific topic, which is batch jobs.
cues.zh: 大家好，這支 C# AI 影片要介紹 OpenAI 與 Azure OpenAI 的批次工作。

cues.en: So batch jobs is a way for you to get your AI much cheaper, meaning 50% off, if you can wait for the responses.
cues.zh: 如果能等待回覆，批次工作能讓 AI 費用便宜一半，也就是五折。

cues.en: So let's see what that is in details.
cues.zh: 接著看看細節。

cues.en: Because there's a lot to go for batches, because if you check a normal LLM call, it has the
cues.zh: 批次有不少優點。一般 LLM 呼叫會依照，

cues.en: normal model price, depending on the model you choose, of course, while a batch job will actually only cost you 50% of that, meaning half.
cues.zh: 所選模型的標準價格計費，批次工作則只需支付百分之五十。

cues.en: It also gets you much higher rate limits, like 10x rate limits on certain models.
cues.zh: 它也提供高得多的速率限制，部分模型甚至有十倍額度。

cues.en: Newer models is slightly less.
cues.zh: 新模型可能稍微少一些。

cues.en: So what's not to like, well, there is the difference of that a normal job, you will
cues.zh: 那有什麼缺點？一般請求，

cues.en: be guaranteed instant processing, it begins to work with your data, while in a batch job, you can technically wait up to 24 hours before you get your job back.
cues.zh: 會立刻開始處理資料，而批次工作在最長情況下，可能要等二十四小時才取得結果。

cues.en: In real life, for low number of requests, it's much faster, which we'll see in one second
cues.zh: 實際上，請求數量少時通常快得多，稍後會，

cues.en: in a demo, but they are not guaranteeing it to happen.
cues.zh: 實際示範，但服務不保證立即完成。

cues.en: So what is actually happening is, when they feel there's no spikes in the number of requests
cues.zh: 它的運作方式是，當 LLM 的請求量，

cues.en: going to the LLMs, they will process these batch jobs on the fly.
cues.zh: 沒有尖峰時，利用空閒資源處理批次工作。

cues.en: While there's high traffic, you will get less true.
cues.zh: 流量高的時候，批次處理速度就比較慢。

cues.en: So when there's much traffic in, for example, US waking up, then batching will take longer,
cues.zh: 例如美國開始上班時，流量變大，批次可能需要更久，

cues.en: but within 24 hours, you will get your result.
cues.zh: 但目標是在二十四小時內完成。

cues.en: Both of them can do chats, client and responses API, and embeddings.
cues.zh: 兩者都能用於 Chat Completions、Responses API 與 Embeddings。

cues.en: So you can also take your embeddings and do in batches if need be.
cues.zh: 所以有需要，也能批次產生嵌入向量。

cues.en: There's some limits in that you can max send out 50,000 requests per file of a batch, because
cues.zh: 有些限制需要注意：每個批次檔案最多五萬筆請求，因為，

cues.en: a batch is happening by sending a file to the LLM, instead of just the individual request.
cues.zh: 批次是透過上傳檔案給服務，而不是逐一送出請求。

cues.en: And it can max be 200 megabytes, that's quite a lot, so we're probably not going to limit you going to hit, or else you can send multiple batches.
cues.zh: 檔案最大 200 MB，已經相當大，通常不會碰到上限；必要時也能分成多個批次。

cues.en: And tool calls are not really supported.
cues.zh: 工具呼叫則不太適合。

cues.en: You can technically give a tool, but then the response back from the batch will just be, hey, I want to run this tool, and then you need to send a new batch with the tool in it.
cues.zh: 技術上可以提供工具，但批次結果只會表示想呼叫哪個工具，接著你還得帶著工具結果再提交新批次。

cues.en: So it is possible, but in reality, you probably wouldn't want to use that part of it for this.
cues.zh: 所以不是完全做不到，只是實務上大概不會這樣使用。

cues.en: So let's see this in action.
cues.zh: 接著實際看看。

cues.en: So I have, under other topics here, I have something called batch jobs, and right now I'm using OpenAI, but Azure OpenAI is also possible.
cues.zh: Other Topics 底下有 Batch Jobs，目前使用 OpenAI，也可以改用 Azure OpenAI。

cues.en: We will talk about that at the end, because there's slight differences in what we need to do.
cues.zh: 最後會談 Azure 的部分，因為有些小差異。

cues.en: So let's run this.
cues.zh: 開始執行。

cues.en: And the first thing we do is, of course, we make our client like normal, and then we make a file client.
cues.zh: 首先像平常一樣建立用戶端，再取得 FileClient。

cues.en: We have seen file clients before in other topics, but that is just to put up a file into OpenAI.
cues.zh: 前面其他主題看過 FileClient，它只是負責把檔案上傳到 OpenAI。

cues.en: And, again, I could switch out the OpenAI client with the Azure OpenAI client to be exactly the same.
cues.zh: 同樣可以把 OpenAIClient 換成 AzureOpenAIClient，用法相同。

cues.en: And then I get something called a batch client as well, because we need to upload what we want to have processed by the LLM using a file,
cues.zh: 接著取得 BatchClient，因為需要先以檔案上傳要交給 LLM 處理的工作，

cues.en: and we need to upload one called JSON-L for JSON lists.
cues.zh: 檔案格式是 JSONL，也就是逐行 JSON。

cues.en: And if we look at that file over here, it is just a set of JSON.
cues.zh: 看看這個檔案，它是一組 JSON 物件。

cues.en: So one line equals one JSON.
cues.zh: 一行就是一個 JSON 物件。

cues.en: You can't even put in line breaks.
cues.zh: 不能在單一物件中任意插入換行。

cues.en: You need to have them on one line.
cues.zh: 每個物件必須放在同一行。

cues.en: And you essentially tell, I want to have a job being done, giving it a unique ID.
cues.zh: 基本上是描述一個工作，並指定唯一的 ID。

cues.en: It needs to be post.
cues.zh: HTTP 方法是 POST。

cues.en: It needs to go against the completion endpoint.
cues.zh: 送到 Chat Completions 端點，

cues.en: It could be responses endpoint or embedding endpoint.
cues.zh: 也可以是 Responses 或 Embeddings 端點。

cues.en: It needs to be this model that does it, and then you send your messages.
cues.zh: 指定使用的模型，再提供訊息。

cues.en: So in this case, we're just sending a system message with nice AI, and a role of the user where we can send that along.
cues.zh: 這裡送出一則要求友善回答的系統訊息，以及使用者角色的問題。

cues.en: So if we do it like this, we can send three requests.
cues.zh: 這個範例會送出三筆請求。

cues.en: So in this case, we are asking, why is the sky blue?
cues.zh: 第一筆問：「天空為什麼是藍色？」

cues.en: What is the capital of France?
cues.zh: 第二筆：「法國首都是哪裡？」

cues.en: And what is a JSON-L file?
cues.zh: 第三筆：「什麼是 JSONL 檔案？」

cues.en: Which I actually didn't know about these files before that.
cues.zh: 其實在做這個範例之前，我也不知道這種檔案。

cues.en: So in OpenAI, we just give the model name like normal.
cues.zh: OpenAI 直接提供一般的模型名稱。

cues.en: If you're going to do this against Azure OpenAI, it's slightly different, because there, what you put in model here is the deployments.
cues.zh: Azure OpenAI 稍有不同，這裡的 model 要填部署名稱。

cues.en: And up in Azure, when we do deployments up here with our models,
cues.zh: 到 Azure 的模型部署頁面，

cues.en: each model are either set as a global standard or a global batch.
cues.zh: 每個部署會有 Global Standard 或 Global Batch 等類型。

cues.en: So I made one here called global batch.
cues.zh: 我在這裡建立了一個 Global Batch 部署。

cues.en: And it's only the deployment type global batch that will work together with the system.
cues.zh: 必須使用支援批次的部署類型，才能配合這套機制。

cues.en: But when you deploy a model, it's fairly simple to do.
cues.zh: 部署模型時，設定其實很簡單。

cues.en: We take and see if we can choose batch here on this one.
cues.zh: 看看這個模型能不能選 Batch。

cues.en: But if you go into custom, you choose here.
cues.zh: 進入自訂設定，就可以在這裡選擇。

cues.en: In this case, it's codec, so it can't do it.
cues.zh: 這個是 Codex 模型，不能這樣做。

cues.en: But you will normally choose the model here.
cues.zh: 一般會先在這裡選模型。

cues.en: So let's go to nano and have this one we want to deploy as a batch.
cues.zh: 改選 Nano，並把它部署成批次用途。

cues.en: And we can choose global batch or data zone batch if we want to do that as well.
cues.zh: 可以選 Global Batch，也能選 Data Zone Batch。

cues.en: So we can definitely do that up here.
cues.zh: 所以在這裡就能設定。

cues.en: And that's the reason why I have a separate file if I want to do it using Azure.
cues.zh: 這也是為什麼 Azure 版本會另外準備一份請求檔案。

cues.en: But back to the code.
cues.zh: 回到程式碼。

cues.en: So in our case, we're just using the one that used HTTP 4.1 mini.
cues.zh: 這裡使用 GPT-4.1 mini 的版本。

cues.en: So we get our file.
cues.zh: 先取得檔案。

cues.en: And now it's uploaded to the system.
cues.zh: 現在檔案已上傳到系統。

cues.en: And we need to tell the purpose of that file is batch, else it can't pick it up.
cues.zh: 上傳時用途必須指定為 Batch，否則批次系統無法使用。

cues.en: And then we're going to make something called a create batch request.
cues.zh: 接著建立 CreateBatchRequest。

cues.en: Because this is a very open-ended system.
cues.zh: 因為這是一個很開放的系統，

cues.en: So there's no real out-of-the-box objects for these.
cues.zh: 沒有直接提供完整的強型別請求物件。

cues.en: So instead, we need to make our own object here, where we need to have an input file ID, an endpoint, and a completion window.
cues.zh: 所以要自行建立物件，包含 InputFileId、Endpoint 與 CompletionWindow。

cues.en: And we're giving the ID of the file we just uploaded.
cues.zh: 提供剛才上傳的檔案 ID。

cues.en: We're telling it's completions.
cues.zh: 指定使用 Completions。

cues.en: And we're telling it's a window of 24 hours.
cues.zh: 完成時限設定為二十四小時。

cues.en: It's a little odd that they have this, because it's the only option you can give.
cues.zh: 這個參數有點奇怪，因為目前只接受這個值。

cues.en: But when we do that, we get something called a binary content.
cues.zh: 然後轉成 BinaryContent。

cues.en: And we can say we want to create a batch.
cues.zh: 接著要求建立批次。

cues.en: We can wait for the batch to complete.
cues.zh: 也可以選擇等待批次完成，

cues.en: So it will just sit and wait.
cues.zh: 程式就會一直等待。

cues.en: But in real life, you will probably not wait for the batch.
cues.zh: 不過實際應用通常不會在這裡等。

cues.en: I've seen batches come back between 20 seconds and 4 minutes for these three things.
cues.zh: 這三個問題，我看過二十秒到四分鐘之間完成。

cues.en: But of course, with much more, it will take longer.
cues.zh: 當然，請求更多時可能更久。

cues.en: But just to simulate that we're not waiting, we start a batch.
cues.zh: 為了模擬不等待的情境，先只啟動批次。

cues.en: So you can see it didn't take a long time.
cues.zh: 可以看到，建立本身沒有花很久。

cues.en: And we just get back that we have a batch ID.
cues.zh: 它只是回傳一個 Batch ID。

cues.en: So we're writing out our batch ID here.
cues.zh: 所以先把 Batch ID 印出來。

cues.en: And then we're going to go into a while loop and ask, how is our batch doing?
cues.zh: 接著進入 while 迴圈，檢查批次目前的狀態。

cues.en: So there's three termination statuses that we need to listen for.
cues.zh: 這裡監聽三種結束狀態，

cues.en: Completed, expired, or canceled.
cues.zh: Completed、Expired 或 Cancelled。

cues.en: So we can either complete it, get it completed.
cues.zh: 也就是正常完成，

cues.en: It can expire if it didn't finish within the 24 hours.
cues.zh: 超過二十四小時仍未完成而到期，

cues.en: Or we have an endpoint that can say, we want to cancel this batch.
cues.zh: 或透過取消端點要求取消批次，

cues.en: We don't want to run it anymore.
cues.zh: 表示不想繼續執行。

cues.en: Then it's possible to do that.
cues.zh: 這也是可以做到的。

cues.en: So we have the options of validating, failed, in progress, and so on.
cues.zh: 另外還有 Validating、Failed、InProgress 等狀態。

cues.en: So if we take these different termination statuses and just start a clock,
cues.zh: 把這些結束狀態準備好，再啟動計時，

cues.en: we can go in and check if the status of a batch, which we use the batch client again and say, get batch.
cues.zh: 就能透過 BatchClient.GetBatch 查詢目前狀態。

cues.en: Right now, I have a delay here of 10 seconds we need to wait for first.
cues.zh: 這裡先設定延遲十秒。

cues.en: Because in real life, it would not complete within those.
cues.zh: 因為通常不會在那麼短的時間內全部完成。

cues.en: We will now get a batch result back.
cues.zh: 接著取得批次查詢結果。

cues.en: And this batch result don't really have anything directly for us.
cues.zh: 這個結果沒有直接提供我們要的所有強型別資訊，

cues.en: Because again, it's a very open-ended system.
cues.zh: 因為這是一個很開放的系統。

cues.en: So the real thing we get back is actually this JSON.
cues.zh: 實際取得的是這份 JSON。

cues.en: And in this case, we can see now it's in progress.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到目前是 InProgress。

cues.en: When it started, what is the output file and all kinds of things of the request.
cues.zh: 包含開始時間、輸出檔案，以及請求相關資訊。

cues.en: But right now, it's still running.
cues.zh: 不過目前仍在執行。

cues.en: And if we go to OpenAI, we can go in and check the batches up here.
cues.zh: 也能到 OpenAI 的 Batches 頁面查看。

cues.en: And it's actually now finished because it ran for 12.
cues.zh: 這次其實已經完成，大約跑了十二秒。

cues.en: So let's just quickly restart the code with a new batch so we can see this in more seconds.
cues.zh: 我們快速重新執行，建立另一個批次，方便再觀察久一點。

cues.en: So let's get it running.
cues.zh: 開始執行。

cues.en: Let now have a new batch.
cues.zh: 現在有新的批次。

cues.en: We will be able to see there's a new batch up here. It's running.
cues.zh: 上方能看到它正在執行。

cues.en: It's already completed the first of the three.
cues.zh: 三筆裡已經完成第一筆。

cues.en: And if we go to the code, I've just set up that every 10 seconds, it should give us back how far it's along.
cues.zh: 回到程式，這裡只是每十秒查詢一次進度。

cues.en: And we can set a breakpoint here.
cues.zh: 也可以在這裡設中斷點。

cues.en: Because we are always asking for the response back here, which have a status, some counts, and output files.
cues.zh: 每次回覆中會有狀態、完成數量，以及輸出檔案等資訊。

cues.en: So this time, it takes a little longer.
cues.zh: 這次需要稍微久一點。

cues.en: And we are essentially waiting for one of the statuses to be completed, expired, or canceled.
cues.zh: 基本上就是等待狀態變成 Completed、Expired 或 Cancelled。

cues.en: And once we get that, it will go out of our loop.
cues.zh: 一旦符合，就離開迴圈。

cues.en: Of course, in real life, you wouldn't make a while loop like this.
cues.zh: 實際應用當然不會一直用這樣的 while 迴圈等。

cues.en: You would instead have some kind of job that checked every 30 minutes or however long you feel like your batches will be.
cues.zh: 可能改用排程工作，每三十分鐘，或依照預期批次時間來檢查。

cues.en: And up here, we can now see it's finalizing.
cues.zh: 上方現在顯示 Finalizing。

cues.en: So we can also see that status here.
cues.zh: 這裡也能取得相同狀態。

cues.en: So we should be very, very close to getting our result back, meaning our output file here will end up having a value.
cues.zh: 所以應該很快就會得到結果，這個 OutputFileId 也會有值。

cues.en: So now our output and status is completed.
cues.zh: 現在狀態已經是 Completed。

cues.en: We go out of the while loop.
cues.zh: 離開 while 迴圈。

cues.en: We now have our output file.
cues.zh: 現在有輸出檔案了。

cues.en: And we can download the output.
cues.zh: 接著可以下載輸出。

cues.en: So in this case, I'm just downloading it to a temp folder.
cues.zh: 我這裡下載到暫存資料夾。

cues.en: And then I'm showing it to you in Notepad here.
cues.zh: 再用記事本展示給你看。

cues.en: So if we take this and look at a JSON viewer, there's no real good JSON viewer for JSONL files.
cues.zh: 如果想用 JSON 檢視器查看，JSONL 並沒有特別好用的檢視方式。

cues.en: But if we look in here, we can see we have the first result back, the second result back, and the third result back.
cues.zh: 不過這裡可以看到第一、第二與第三筆結果。

cues.en: And the first result was, why is the sky blue?
cues.zh: 第一個問題是天空為什麼是藍色。

cues.en: And you can see we only get the response back.
cues.zh: 可以看到，我們只取得回覆，

cues.en: We don't even get what the questions were.
cues.zh: 甚至不會附上原本的問題。

cues.en: So we need to match our own ID of the request with our own response here.
cues.zh: 所以必須用自己的 Request ID，對應回傳的結果。

cues.en: So we need to save the request as well and then merge them.
cues.zh: 也就是保存原始請求，再把結果合併回去。

cues.en: But that's normal, C sharp.
cues.zh: 不過那只是一般 C# 資料處理，

cues.en: So we won't go into that.
cues.zh: 這裡就不深入。

cues.en: But we can get back why the sky is blue.
cues.zh: 總之能取得天空為什麼是藍色的解釋。

cues.en: We can get back what is the capital of France in the second request.
cues.zh: 第二筆取得法國首都。

cues.en: And the third one was, what is a JSONL file?
cues.zh: 第三筆則說明什麼是 JSONL。

cues.en: So if we have a look at the final part here, it's just we download the file and we save it.
cues.zh: 最後這段程式碼，只是下載檔案並儲存。

cues.en: So we need a little of this extra thing with some objects here.
cues.zh: 需要額外定義這些小型物件。

cues.en: You can just copy paste mine here.
cues.zh: 可以直接複製我的版本。

cues.en: And there's a bunch more data in them, of course, as we saw.
cues.zh: 實際回應當然還包含剛才看到的更多資料。

cues.en: But this way, we have now asked three questions.
cues.zh: 透過這種方式，我們完成了三個問題。

cues.en: We spent a couple of minutes.
cues.zh: 等待大約幾分鐘，

cues.en: We can see that up here.
cues.zh: 上方可以看到時間。

cues.en: I need to refresh here so we can see.
cues.zh: 重新整理一下。

cues.en: So it took one minute and 26 seconds to get those three messages.
cues.zh: 這次三筆訊息花了一分二十六秒。

cues.en: And that would, of course, not be good for a chatbot.
cues.zh: 這當然不適合即時聊天機器人。

cues.en: But it would be good if it's just some background job.
cues.zh: 但如果只是背景工作，就很適合。

cues.en: And now we have saved 50% of our price just for waiting.
cues.zh: 單純因為願意等待，就節省了百分之五十的費用。

cues.en: So this is really, really good for some big advanced stuff where you really, really hit your rate limits.
cues.zh: 所以對大型、複雜，而且容易碰到速率限制的工作，非常有幫助。

cues.en: Or you just want to have it more cheap.
cues.zh: 或只是想降低成本，也能使用。

cues.en: There's more work for you because you need to do all these extra steps in the code.
cues.zh: 不過程式需要做更多事，因為多了這些額外步驟。

cues.en: And the biggest problem, of course, is things like structured output and tools that is more difficult to work with here.
cues.zh: 主要麻煩是結構化輸出與工具呼叫，在這種流程中處理起來比較複雜。

cues.en: But we can do it.
cues.zh: 但仍然做得到。

cues.en: And it's really nice that we can.
cues.zh: 而且有這個選項很不錯。

cues.en: Azure have exactly the same.
cues.zh: Azure 也有完全相同的功能。

cues.en: If we go to the models again, go into build.
cues.zh: 再次進入模型頁面，開啟 Build，

cues.en: Go to the models.
cues.zh: 找到模型，

cues.en: We can see our batch jobs.
cues.zh: 就能查看批次工作。

cues.en: The only real difference I have seen is it can't really on the fly, like we saw here, tell how many of them were completed.
cues.zh: 我目前看到的主要差異，是它不像剛才 OpenAI 那樣，即時顯示完成了幾筆。

cues.en: It seems like it stays at zero.
cues.zh: 看起來會一直維持零，

cues.en: And then it suddenly goes to complete it all.
cues.zh: 然後突然全部變成完成。

cues.en: But that's the only difference in what I have seen in the two differences.
cues.zh: 這是我在兩個系統間觀察到的唯一差異。

cues.en: But again, we need to deploy a dedicated model for batching.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，Azure 必須另外部署批次專用的模型。

cues.en: But else it works exactly the same just with the Azure OpenAI Cloud.
cues.zh: 除此之外，只是改用 AzureOpenAIClient，運作完全相同。

cues.en: So that's everything there is to know about batching.
cues.zh: 以上就是批次處理的介紹。

cues.en: Really nice subject if you need to have some really, really big payloads.
cues.zh: 對非常大量的工作內容而言，是個很實用的主題。

cues.en: So see you in the next one.
cues.zh: 我們下支影片見。
